decision_basis: Completed 300.92-second CPU and 301.28-second MPS end-to-end Pong benchmark; separate 128-episode learning-rate pilots on tuning seed 92.
evaluation_action_rule: sample categorical policy; identical per-episode seed protocol across methods
standard_deviation: sample, ddof=1; population ddof=0 also saved
stopping_rule: Fixed 4096 complete training episodes per run. Final checkpoint at this budget is frozen before 500 held-out evaluations; no evaluation-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.
scope_and_limits: One matched training seed per environment/method. Local implementation and method comparison, not a claim of solving Pong or estimating across-seed uncertainty.
